row:
Minton Farm rescues koalas, kangaroos, possums, owls, hawks, eagles, lorikeets, rosellas, parrots, magpies, kookaburras, tawny frogmouths, lizards and tortoises and plays home to a euro, horses, lamb, goats, deer, emus, seagulls, peacocks and a menagerie of other animals.

Minton Farm is a non-government, not for profit, voluntarily operated organisation operating solely on donations, volunteer input and community goodwill.

One of the most of the important goals for Minton Farm is to rehabilitate the animals and return them to where they were originally collected from, so all patients are documented and records kept, ensuring the animals can be released back into their environment.

You can find out more about Minton Farm Animal Rescue Centre's work and animal care tips by visiting their website, www.mintonfarm.org
